description: Calculate the interest a buyer owes a micro or small enterprise (Udyam-registered supplier) for paying late, under Section 16 of India's MSMED Act: three times the RBI Bank Rate (17.25% a year as of 7 Oct 2026), compounded monthly, from the day after the payment deadline (the agreed credit period, at most 45 days). Exact to the paisa.

credit_days.description: Agreed credit period in days (default 45; the Act caps it at 45).

invoice_date.description: Date the goods or services were accepted, YYYY-MM-DD (use the invoice date if unsure).

paid_on.description: Payment date, YYYY-MM-DD. Leave out to count up to today.

name: calculate_msmed_interest
title: Calculate MSMED late-payment interest
